summary: Iteration 5 — Annual Tax Summary Dashboard + Bukti Potong 1721-A1 PDF (employee + admin) verified end-to-end. 17/17 new backend tests pass, 31/31 regression tests (test_portal + test_magic_link) still green, all required UI elements present and integrated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1995 lines. Strong candidate for modularising into routers (portal_router.py, payroll_router.py, pdf_utils.py) — not blocking but increasingly hard to maintain.
_build_bukti_potong_pdf imports reportlab inside the function — fine for lazy import but the same pattern repeats elsewhere; consider top-level import for clarity.

Year dropdown in Portal.jsx is hardcoded to [currentYear, currentYear-1, currentYear-2]. Employees with payslip history older than 2 years cannot view/download via UI (backend still serves them). Consider deriving the list from /api/portal/payslips distinct year set, or extending range.

Frontend admin Employees page hardcodes new Date().getFullYear() for the bp- href. No year selector per row — admin cannot download prior-year forms from this page. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

Both PDF endpoints return 404 when no data for the year. Good. But /api/payroll/bukti-potong/{eid}/{year}/pdf returns 404 for unknown employee_id with same code path — ensure error message distinguishes 'employee not found' from 'no data' for better admin UX.
Anti-enumeration nit (carry-over from iter 4): /api/portal/forgot still leaks response-shape difference for known vs unknown emails. Not in scope of this iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Annual Tax Summary feature complete. Backend: GET /api/portal/annual/{year} returns {year, months[], totals{gross,basic,allowance,overtime,bonus,pph21,bpjs_employee,net,thr_gross,thr_pph21}, months_count}. PDF endpoints: /api/portal/bukti-potong/{year}/pdf (employee, scoped to logged-in user, no employee_id parameter — structurally safe) and /api/payroll/bukti-potong/{employee_id}/{year}/pdf (admin only). Both return %PDF bytes ~3KB built via reportlab. Returns 404 when no data. Portal token cannot access admin endpoint (401). Employees.jsx adds 1721-A1 column with data-testid bp-{employee_id} per row pointing to current-year PDF. Verified for Syarifuddin year=2026: months_count=2, totals.gross=800000 (matches spec).
